text: My dear Fortunato. <break time="0.8s" /> I said. <break time="0.8s" /> How lucky I am to meet you. <break time="0.8s" /> Because I have just received. <break time="0.8s" /> A cask of Amontillado. <break time="0.8s" /> But I have my doubts. <break time="0.8s" /> And I was foolish enough. <break time="0.8s" /> To pay the full price. <break time="0.8s" /> Without asking your advice first. <break time="0.8s" /> As I could not find you anywhere. <break time="0.8s" /> I am on my way to Luchresi. <break time="0.8s" /> Who will surely tell me the truth. <break time="0.8s" /> Luchresi cannot tell Amontillado. <break time="0.8s" /> From ordinary sherry. <break time="0.8s" /> Fortunato said. <break time="0.8s" /> And yet some fools say. <break time="0.8s" /> That his taste matches mine. <break time="0.8s" /> Come let us go to your vaults at once. <break time="0.8s" /> For it is I. <break time="0.8s" /> Who must judge the wine. <break time="0.8s" /> He insisted. <break time="0.8s" /> I warned him. <break time="0.8s" /> That the vaults were cold and damp. <break time="0.8s" /> And covered with nitre. <break time="0.8s" /> A white salt. <break time="0.8s" /> That grows on the walls. <break time="0.8s" /> If I had known. <break time="0.8s" /> That you had such a bad cold. <break time="0.8s" /> I would have gone. <break time="0.8s" /> Straight to Luchresi. <break time="0.8s" /> I said. <break time="0.8s" /> The cold is nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> He answered. <break time="0.8s" /> And he took my arm. <break time="0.8s" /> As I put on a black silk mask. <break time="0.8s" /> And a long cloak. <break time="0.8s" /> There were no servants at home. <break time="0.8s" /> For I had told them. <break time="0.8s" /> That I would not return until morning. <break time="0.8s" /> And had ordered them to stay. <break time="0.8s" /> I knew well. <break time="0.8s" /> That this order would send them all. <break time="0.8s" /> Running to the carnival. <break time="0.8s" /> As soon as my back was turned.
